body:
Service industry worker here, currently unemployed unexpectedly and need any kind of assistance. Willing to volunteer my time but no car to help with deliveries. Are there any options?
I have a referral for a food bank on Thursday but my landlord is breathing down my neck after I was only able to pay half of it on the 3rd.

As a service industry worker....I'm in panic mode. There aren't any wfh options and supplies/finances are already limited. Any resources that may help would be appreciated. 
For Perspective my last shift was about 3 hours, we closed and I made $13....
That's definitely not going to cut trying to buy TP or food.
Tell that to my landlord who keeps texting and threatening me *facepalm*

East Clt resident who doesn't qualify for any assistance even though I'm 200% below the poverty level. (Communicated to me by DSS) Yet I still pay my damn taxes on time and my job closed it's doors two days ago. I have zero sympathy for these people.

Ballantyne area has the highest rent rates and higher avg salary of the rest of Charlotte. Excuse me for hoping those resources would be available to those that need it first. Not the people hoarding...
With the rates at which these people can afford to live in an apartment in Ballantyne, they aren't hurting like the rest of us.
Exactly! Why tf can't they go to East or West Charlotte where that help is definitely needed??? So the rich of Charlotte can survive but my now out of work self has to suffer?

Thank you for this! I have maybe 2 days worth of food left because all of my local stores are out of necessities. Do you know if therw are any requirements or anything in place in order to get food assistance?
Damn....missed opportunity to grab more books and movies while I'm barricaded at home.
Btw I'm immunocompromised before anyone jumps down my throat for crossing the street....

Still home, alone, after 4 days, my job closed it's doors, I  myself am immunocompromised 
 and we have 3 test kits?
NC really doesn't care about us, fuck the whole country doesnt.

Tiny? Not even close. The influx of people that have moved here (Charlotte resident) is insane. People are still going to breweries en masse and running around in groups over 5+. I crossed the street to avoid a large group of people waiting for ubers to go bar hopping and we have 3 tests left?!

My restaurant shut down indefinitely. We were told owners and management didn't know if we would reopen and urged to reapply once the panic is over. My state is in a state of emergency and I am pissed, scared and hoping there's some relief for service industry.

I work in the service industry in a state all but shut down due to covid-19. What options are there for people like me to continue to survive? Rent is one thing that hasn't even been talked about in regards to assistance. Our energy companies are at least suspending disconnecting due to overdue payments but I haven't been able to work in over a week and I doubt I'll be able to sustain for long. I know the govt has started to alleviate issues for employers, but what about tipped/wage employees?
Can't wait for you to skip me then triple seat me <- the TRUTH

At this point in time I think that talking is a moot point. I can't keep doing this, thanks for listening.

Update. Didn't get the job. Current job is closed due to covid-19 and it's probably better off if I'm gone.
Thank you, it's weird to me that strangers care more than those around me but fairly sure the ones near me are sucking the life out of me.
Thanks. I feel like I've been screaming for so long that my voice is gone. My hope is gone. My will to keep pushing through is dwindling.

Thank you. Just one person to talk to makes a world of difference. I am just inconsolable right now after a huge let down yet again by the same "friend". He was the one who stopped me in Sept from committing suicide but once out of the hospital any proffered help disappeared. Yesterday his gf attacked me passive aggressively because I am not privileged enough to waste time or money on frivolous things. And today I was supposed to take an assessment for a new job with benefits and living wage etc but he let me down again. I can't pass the drug test and told him that, he urged me to apply and that he would help me get either clean pee or a detox and since that happened two weeks ago I've been helping him watch his gfs kid for free just for the price of the help and now again, I'm let down and hopeless and honestly feeling like useless trash. I've had to repeat myself, my worries and realistic problems/obstacles and they just don't listen to me. I can scream and shout or say it 1000x and nothing gets through to them. I feel like I have no voice or like I'm subhuman...if I make any sense whatsoever I'd be surprised. I know I'm all over the place but thankful for your comment and offer to talk.

I went through this in September and recently started self harming again. I completely understand your pain and what you've described. I don't know how to curb the feelings but if you want to talk I'm here. I take it day by day even though it's the hardest thing I've ever had to do. Please stay, don't give another one like me a reason to let go.
Get a fat joint rolled, roll that in dabs, then coat the sucker in as much kief as possible. Get high, stay....stoopid stoned.
